title: Guarantees for the deterministic small-bias algorithm
statement: Let $n>0$ and let the rational accuracy have positive numerator with twice the numerator at most its denominator. The algorithm has accuracy $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$; its output density is $\varepsilon$-biased and its output multiset has cardinality at most $16(n/\varepsilon)^2$. The corresponding field-based generator density is also $\varepsilon$-biased, its multiset has cardinality at most $16(n/\varepsilon)^2$, and the algorithm's work is at most its polynomial budget.
hypotheses_covered: Twice the accuracy numerator is at most its denominator
